summary_1line: Vyasa praises charity as hardest virtue and begins the story of sage Mudgala, whose patient generosity is repeatedly tested by the ascetic Durvasa.

image_candidates.scene_text: The ragged, wild ascetic Durvasa arrives at Mudgala’s humble hut and devours all the food while the calm sage respectfully serves him.
Mudgala and his family patiently gather scattered grains from fields like pigeons, storing a single drona of corn for their austere life.
As guests arrive at Mudgala’s sacrifice, the small measure of corn miraculously multiplies to feed hundreds of Brahmanas.
